jobs.title: Market Administrative Officer
jobs.description:
Are you a leader people look up to? Do you know brokerage operations principles and regulatory rules by heart?

We’re looking for a market administrative officer to:

• Lead the Operations and Administrative Management Team
• Manage end to end process of recruitment and development of the Operations and Administrative
Management Team and other direct reports where required
• Manage branch administration, including branch facilities and overall cost management to enhance
profitability
• Oversee and approve new client accounts, errors, client correspondence and communications
• Advise and manage HR-related issues in the market
• Ensure that all market/branch employees are educated and receive coaching on administrative policies,
procedures and risk management
• Implement service excellence standards that include coaching and educating Management and support staff
on Client Experience best practices and suitability
• Oversee employee related activity and manage the transition of recruits' accounts

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We are looking for a high impact Equity Advisory Sales professional to aggressively grow and scale our global markets franchise across the region. • Stay ahead of market dynamics, regulatory developments, and product innovation, translating change into commercial opportunity
• Convert market events, research views, and positioning insights into actionable recommendations that help clients generate alpha
• Drive solutions in close partnership with trading, research, product, and structuring teams to deliver seamless client experience.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst – Client Analytics & TCA
jobs.description:
We are seeking a quantitative analyst to provide and support execution consulting, client analytics and transaction cost analysis (TCA) for the APAC Agency Algorithmic Trading platform. The role is analytics led and client facing, with responsibility for explaining execution outcomes and algorithm performance to internal stakeholders and clients.
You will:
• Produce client facing execution analysis and TCA across APAC equity markets.
• Analyse algorithmic execution performance across benchmarks, market conditions, and execution styles.
• Translate quantitative results into clear, actionable insights for client reviews and discussions including practical recommendations on algo usage, parameter choices, and execution trade offs.
• Support analytics methodology, benchmarks, and follow up analysis in response to client and stakeholder questions.
• Work with Trading, Product, Technology, and Control teams to ensure analytics accurately reflect platform behaviour and client flow.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of production analytics used in client reporting, including the scaling and automation of the analytics - helping standardise recurring analyses, improve repeatability, and reduce manual effort.

We are seeking an Associate Director to join the APAC Equity Derivatives Trading desk in Hong Kong. The role focuses on pricing, trading, and risk managing equity derivatives products across Asian markets. You will partner closely with Sales, Structuring, Quant and IT teams to deliver client solutions, manage risk exposures, and identify trading opportunities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Price, execute, and risk manage equity derivatives books across APAC markets
• Conduct market analysis and identify trading opportunities
• Partner with Sales to provide timely pricing, execution support, and client insights
• Collaborate with Structuring and Quants on product development and pricing methodologies
• Contribute to analytics, tooling, and automation initiatives (e.g., Python)
• Ensure adherence to risk controls and regulatory requirements
• Operate effectively in a high-pressure environment with strong decision-making

jobs.title: Spécialiste Crédits 80-100%
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

jobs.title: US Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Tax Specialist to join our UBS Asset Management Tax Team as an Associate Director.
Specifically, the job holder is expected to:
• Collaborate with all business areas of AM across the US region to manage and resolve tax issues related to AM products, including the development of new products and providing specialized asset management tax advice on structuring and efficiency at the fund, investor, and portfolio levels
• Oversee annual tax compliance processes for various fund types (trading funds, private credit funds, fund of funds, mutual funds), ensuring adherence to all relevant regulations
• Manage and monitor FATCA/CRS, FBAR, 1099, and shareholder reporting for UBS AM Funds
• Serve as the primary contact for investor inquiries regarding tax reporting deliverables, ensuring timely and accurate responses and thorough reviews of investor deliverables (e.g., K-1 forms, estimated tax letters)
• Ensure timely filing of all tax returns and compliance with Group Tax policies and supplements
• Manage tax risk (financial and reputational) across the region, including, but not limited to:
o Regular reviews and reporting of tax risk issues to the US Head of AM Tax
o Implementing procedures and controls to mitigate tax risk
o Monitoring tax and operational risk related to third-party service providers (fund administrators, advisors)
• Provide prompt and comprehensive responses to investor inquiries
• Support portfolio managers by addressing fund-related questions concerning jurisdictional requirements, diversification tests, and withholding tax matters
• Support business initiatives through the TRPA process, including pre- and post-launch conditions and coordination with Group Tax specialists for country-specific and indirect/specialist tax sign-off
• Manage the appointment and oversight of external advisors on tax matters, ensuring compliance with UBS internal contract management requirements
• Review of tax wording in fund documentation and other AM relevant legal agreements
• Build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments
• Engage the business in tax matters, reconciling the competing imperatives of the management of tax risk with commercial and regulatory drivers of the business
• Ensure that the AM business adhere to the Group Tax policies and supplements

jobs.title: Fund Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise?
We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives.
The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

jobs.title: Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain the extension of the functionality within analytics libraries used for valuation and risk management of UBS’ interest rate, credit, and hybrid derivatives business for business and regulatory requirements. Triage with the trading, IT, and control functions to provide support on modeling and quantitative matters.
• Provide analytical and quantitative support for trading desks that deal with several types of products including all linear interest rate products such as Swaps, Futures, and Government Securities; all Interest Rate Option products including Swaptions, Caps & Floors, exchange traded options; all Structured Rates products including Bermudan Options, Callable Notes, Range Accruals, and Leveraged Steepeners among others; and Structured Hybrid products including the underlying Interest Rate/FX/Equity indices.
• Code mathematical models in our C++ libraries and on tools using Python, Excel/VBA. Contribute to regulatory and model governance requirements by writing model documentation with technical/mathematical descriptions using LaTex and detailed tests using Python within our documentation framework.
• Provide support and input to the trading desk in usage of our stochastic-volatility Model, the SABR model, and related risk functionality including interest rate volatility risk, skew/smile, and interest rate risk measures. Support the interest rate options trading desk’s end of day model publishing and calibration processes. Tasked with investigations of day-to-day risk-based P&L attribution and explanation of any unexplained P&L and for generating solutions and improvements.
• Work in Python to provide the trading desk with various visualization and relative value tools to aid them with the pricing and marking of models. Be involved with the migration of our books to a strategic trading and risk management platform. Implement new pricing methodologies and modeling enhancements to the stochastic volatility model and SABR model in our C++ libraries to support Options and Structured Rates businesses.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002879. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary Range & Work Schedule: $160,000 to $225,000/year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, Global Markets FX Trader to:
• Core mandate is CAD & EUR STIR trader and back up coverage of USD, JPY, AUD, NZD and Scandinavian currencies Pricing / Risk management of Interest Rate Swaps, Forward Rate Agreements, Fx-Swaps, XCCY Basis Swaps, Interest Rate Futures and Government Bond Futures.

Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Officer - Hedge Funds
jobs.description:
Your role
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have strong analytical skills? We’re looking for someone who can:
•assess counterparty credit risk using a solid understanding of hedge fund and family office risk management, trading strategies, infrastructure, and other quantitative and qualitative credit factors, including onsite due diligence
•use delegated authority, within defined risk limits, to approve new positions or recommend decisions to senior credit committees, working closely with the business to ensure transactions align with UBS’s risk appetite
• •evaluate transactional risk across OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange-traded derivatives, banking products, and structured transactions
• •prepare, review, and approve annual counterparty reviews and transactional credit proposals, clearly setting out credit assessments, risk appetite, exposure drivers, and business outlook
• •lead negotiation of trading documentation, including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage, and Repo Agreements
• •manage regulatory requests, audit items, and operational risk issues in a timely and disciplined way
• •deliver ad hoc credit analysis and contribute to portfolio reviews to identify emerging risks and concentrations

jobs.title: Competitive Underwriter
jobs.description:
The Competitive Underwriter is responsible for pricing, structuring, and executing municipal bond transactions in competitive sale processes. This role partners closely with sales and trading to evaluate deals, develop bid strategies, and manage risk to maximize win rates and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Evaluation & Pricing
• Analyze municipal bond announcements for competitive bids
• Build pricing scales, yield curves, and relative value assessments
• Evaluate credit fundamentals, structure, call features, and investor demand
• Determine optimal bid levels balancing risk, return, and win probability

Market Strategy & Execution
• Develop and execute bidding strategies for competitive transactions
• Monitor market conditions (rates, flows, supply/demand, comparable trades)
• Coordinate with trading desk on secondary levels and positioning
• Submit bids and manage award process in real time

Risk Management
• Assess market and inventory risk associated with awarded deals
• Work with trading to hedge or distribute risk efficiently
• Ensure adherence to firm risk limits and capital usage guidelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with:
• Sales: gauge investor demand and pricing appetite
• Trading: align on secondary levels and liquidity
• Provide feedback to improve competitiveness

Post-Award Execution
• Support allocation, distribution, and secondary market trading strategies
• Monitor performance of won deals and refine future pricing approaches
• Maintain records of bids, outcomes, and competitor behavior

jobs.title: Integrated Middle Office Specialist
jobs.description:
D&S – Credit & Rates Team - Integrated Middle Office Specialist _ EE

Your role
Are you inquisitive with analytical and risk-aware mindset to solve day-to-day process problems? Do you know how to get the words out? We are looking for someone like this to:
- Ensure Completeness, Accuracy and Timeliness ("CAT") requirements Trade capture controls and Trade Lifecycle controls for our Investment banking derivatives trades in FRC. This includes daily exceptions management of intersystem reconciliations at transaction/position/cash level, also the associated reporting activities, and ensuring appropriate escalation of items
- Work with other TLCS ("Trade Lifecycle Services") stakeholders as well as Regulatory Transaction Reporting teams to properly address issues raised
- Actively and continually provide ideas and execute on process improvements in the exception management and data quality of submission to clients
- Be the subject matter expert in all team activities and support teams and peripheral stakeholders.
